title: Console backlog sieve + Q2 sprint cutlist
body:
Purpose:
- Rapidly triage console + tooling backlog and produce a Q2 cutlist. Focus on items that unblock Dedicated/Private rollout stories and reduce operational toil for SRE and Solutions Engineering.

Context / constraints:
- Q2 capacity: 2 full-time sprint teams on Console (team A + team B), 3-week sprint cadence. Each sprint target ~45 story points per team.
- High-level priorities from leadership: 1) Dedicated onboarding flow, 2) Rollouts dashboard stability, 3) Lower mean time to resolution for token/cost attribution bugs.
- Several infra migrations planned (feature-flagging backend change) in mid-April—minimize risky surface area prior to that cutover.

Triage summary (first-pass):
- Red (blocker/high): must include in next two sprints unless mitigated via manual workaround.
  * CON-1283: Rollouts dashboard stale state when model variant swaps (SE reports production impact) — estimate 8 sp — impact: Dedicated customers see incorrect active variant; automated canary fails. (owner: Diego)
  * UI-342: Token breakdown panel mislabels secondary costs under rare paths (billing reconciliation risk) — estimate 5 sp — impact: finance/customer billing mismatches. (owner: Aisha)

- Amber (important): prioritize if capacity remains, otherwise schedule after immediate Q2 milestones.
  * CON-1301: Console: Route-level latency heatmap (initial wireframes exist) — estimate 8 sp — customer-facing, moderate ROI for performance troubleshooting. (owner: Lena)
  * CON-1318: Quick-create for Dedicated clusters (wizard guardrails missing) — estimate 5 sp — reduces SE onboarding time from hours to 20m. (owner: Samira)

- Green (nice-to-have): backlog candidates for later sprints; long lead or research items.
  * CON-1404: Rework alert templating UX for SLO alerts — estimate 3 sp research + later work.
  * CON-1412: Dark-theme polish across console pages — estimate 4 sp.

Prioritization rationale (short):- Blockers that cause incorrect customer-visible state or billing discrepancies = top priority.
- Items that directly reduce manual SE/SRE work or onboarding time = next.
- Cosmetic / low-impact UX improvements = lowest priority.

Q2 cutlist proposal (committed scope for next 2 sprints across both teams):
Sprint 1 (Mar 30 start) 
- Team A (45 sp): CON-1283 fix (8 sp), UI-342 bug + test coverage (5 sp), CON-1318 kickoff + validation (5 sp), tech debt: snackbar error standardization (6 sp), buffer for emergent (21 sp).
- Team B (45 sp): CON-1301 wireframe -> MVP API integration (8 sp), analytics: add event hooks to rollout flows (5 sp), QA: rollout e2e scenarios (6 sp), small tasks & infra prep (26 sp).

Sprint 2 (Apr 20 start) 
- Team A (45 sp): finish CON-1318 (5 sp), rollout follow-ups for CON-1283 (4 sp), deep-dive on billing edge-case reproduction & fix for UI-342 (5 sp), start CON-1404 research (3 sp), misc bug backlog (28 sp).
- Team B (45 sp): CON-1301 heatmap polish + perf optimizations (8 sp), add feature-flag migration compatibility layer (6 sp), update docs + support runbook for new rollout behaviors (4 sp), buffer (27 sp).

Cutlist (items deferred / dropped this cycle):
- CON-1412 dark-theme polish -> defer to post-migration sprint (low priority).
- CON-1420 multi-org telemetry UI -> defer (higher infra dependency).
- CON-1356 onboarding videos embedded in console -> defer (move to docs-led initiative).

Open questions / unresolved risks:
- Does the feature-flagging migration require a hard freeze on non-critical UI changes? Action: reach out to infra owner (Mira Chen) for a migration calendar by 2026-03-14.
- Rollouts dashboard root cause: flaky cache invalidation vs event-ordering bug? Action: Diego to attach logs and reproduce steps in CON-1283 by 2026-03-12.
- Billing bug reproducibility in prod vs staging — need a small sampling job to re-run historical requests. Action: Aisha to file small ENG instrumentation spike, estimate 2 sp.

Acceptance criteria highlights (per high-priority ticket):
- CON-1283: Dashboard displays correct active variant consistently within 2s of backend change; automated canary run passes in our staging cluster for 10 consecutive runs.
- UI-342: Token breakdown labels match billing export for 99.9% of daily aggregates across sample customer accounts; test coverage added.

Owner assignments & immediate actions (by 2026-03-14):
- Marco: finalize sprint allocation and notify engineering managers.
- Diego: reproduce CON-1283 failure, attach logs, propose patch.
- Aisha: instrument billing sampling job and validate label mismatch hypothesis.
- Lena: finalize heatmap API contract and provide wireframes for dev.
- Samira: prototype Dedicated quick-create wizard and write acceptance tests.

Notes to reviewers:
- This doc is intentionally opinionated; shepherd any disagreements into the PRD thread (linked_artifacts). If you think an item marked green should be raised, add rationale and a concrete rollback mitigation.
- Keep the cutlist lean—we will accept trade-offs for short-term reliability ahead of cosmetic wins.

Appendix: rough story-point assumptions used for planning:
- Small bug with clear repro: 2-3 sp
- Medium bug / small feature: 5 sp
- Cross-team feature with infra work: 8-13 sp

End of note.
